5. Observation, false seats and the finite fault family

The proposed fault envelope is deliberately bounded.

Fault	Represented admission	Required response
Placement error	Up to ±8 mm in the exercised offset direction	Image-based correction and renewed proof
Seated-looking wrong path	Local shunt or one-cheek engagement	Reject staged proof; retain support
Loaded second-end jam	Internal 0.5–2.5 kN force; 0.5–5 MN/m contact stiffness	Capture both contact and counterhold
Degraded member	40% represented stiffness; separately qualified ≥6 kN residual capacity	Detect and independently support before removal
Persistent driver fault	Stalled drive or partly completed cup stroke	Brake, exchange finite drive stock, resume from observed position
Failed first spare	One replacement also fails	Quarantine it and use the remaining admitted stock
Power interruption	Within retained-brake and support admissions	Retain mechanically; reobserve before continuing

Arbitrary root loss, an advancing crack outside the residual-strength interval, uncontrolled collapse and an unbounded foreign tie crossing the extraction boundary are outside continued-operation admission.

Staged proof remains essential

The tests are signed 150, 300 and 1,000 N, with independent 200, 350 and 1,100 N mechanical caps.

and compares that result with the two pin-plane observations, tip positions and gaps. The subtraction matters because surrounding frame paths can receive some of the proof force.

In the bounded synthetic proof test:

All 300 healthy cases were accepted.
None of the 300 absent-path cases were accepted.
None of the 300 one-cheek cases were accepted.
None of the 300 represented parallel-shunt cases were accepted.
All 300 paths deliberately constructed to imitate every witness were accepted.

The final category is a reported indistinguishability result. It must be excluded by an actual guarded boundary or handled using additional independent evidence. More confidence in the same sensor trace does not solve it.

The separate prepared-collar damage probe classified 200 introduced healthy/degraded cases, but only 64 of its 91 required geometric targets pass the current route check. A good local measurement model therefore does not supply the required inspection service.
